copy.tagline: 分析数学建模题目并推荐模型算法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在准备数学建模竞赛或需要为科研问题选择数学模型。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze math modeling problems and recommend models and algorithms.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are preparing for a math modeling contest or need to select a mathematical model for research.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析数学建模题目，理解问题、选择模型和设计算法，并输出一份题目分析报告和一个术语表格。
howto.when: 当你给出数学建模题目和附件，要求 Claude 开始分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这道数学建模题，输出题目分析报告和术语表。
say.note: Claude 会读取题目并生成两个文件。

say.text: 针对子问题一，推荐两个模型并说明理由。
say.note: Claude 会评估候选模型并给出选择依据。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you analyze mathematical modeling problems, understand the problem, select models, and design algorithms. It outputs a problem analysis report and a terminology table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a mathematical modeling problem and attachments, and ask Claude to start analysis.

say_en.text: Analyze this math modeling problem and output the problem analysis report and terminology table.
say_en.note: Claude will read the problem and generate two files.

say_en.text: Recommend two models for subproblem 1 with reasons.
say_en.note: Claude will evaluate candidate models and provide selection rationale.
